title: Beta World Creation Screen
description: Mod that brings the old and classic feel of world creation menu. No more tabs, just one clean page with elements
body:
# Beta World Menu
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/_g1sSoDP5QA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
Replaces modern minecraft menu with a simpler one, which fits beta aesthethic better.

# You can set world type to be generated in mod's config or mod-menu page
![Config Page in Mod Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b48f8d179f5e43f862ac8c8094da7f8c4d869fe7.png)

**Note**: To get entries from mods **open** the **world creation screen** to **update the entries**.

# Credits
Special thanks to [RaderRMT](https://modrinth.com/user/RaderRMT) and his mod [Timeless](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless)
